instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Set <html dir='rtl' lang='ar'> in the root document to ensure Tailwind's RTL features work correctly.
Use Manrope for all headings (h1-h6) and labels, Inter for body text, and JetBrains Mono exclusively for numbers, currency (SAR), and percentages.
Implement a 3-column layout on desktop: Left sidebar for quick navigation (anchors), Middle wide column for forms/inputs, Right sticky sidebar for the Real-time Dashboard.
For inputs, prefer dense, professional layouts. Use a Grid system (e.g. grid-cols-2 or grid-cols-3) inside cards to pack fields efficiently without looking cluttered.
Use React Hook Form or a robust state management solution to ensure all calculations update in real-time on the right dashboard.
The Right Dashboard must always be visible (`sticky top-8`) and contain: Total Revenue (SAR), Profit margin, Cost Breakdown chart/bars, and clear Warning alerts if margins drop below guidelines.
Implement the 'Split Margins' toggle and Risk sliders cleanly. Use Lucide icons to indicate 'Complexity', 'Rush', 'Execution'.
Every interactive element MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid='add-team-member-btn').
For the Team and Vendor tables, use a compact design: hide borders between rows, use a solid background for the header row, and keep padding tight (`py-2`).

Do not use generic Teal/Purple gradients. Stick strictly to the monochrome Dark Swiss archetype (Black/Deep Greys) with pure White buttons for primary actions and semantic colors (Emerald/Rose/Amber) ONLY for data/status.
